The map shows a wall at x=8 (column 8 is '#') separating the west and east rooms, with the Gold Door at (7,6) being the only passage. The east room (x=9-12) contains the Workbench, Stone at (9,8), Wood at (9,1), Stone at (10,1). All east-side materials are behind the door too.

So I need to wait for day 3 to get the Gold Key. Let me first grab the remaining west-side materials I can reach. Wood at (4,6) and (2,2) are done. Let me check what's left on the west side.
